evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; the required growth-atmosphere verification is unavailable.
Pressure was 3.002 Torr at the start of growth.
Pressure has risen monotonically through 3.099, 3.148 and 3.238 to 3.339 Torr despite approximately constant argon flow; this is concerning but no expected growth-pressure range is supplied.
Temperature is 750.2 °C against 750 °C setpoint, argon is 100.1 sccm against 100 sccm, and status is running; these do not establish atmosphere integrity.

args.missing_evidence: A functioning exhaust O2 sensor and oxygen acceptance limits are needed to verify the growth atmosphere; expected growth-pressure limits and a leak/exhaust-conductance check would resolve the pressure trend. Sample characterization is not yet available.
